name: synthetic-v1
regenerate: python scripts/synthetic_v1.py generate (needs the user's Native block library and data/di; model ids are read at generation time and kept in cache/)
parameters: continuous CC-verified block parameters on the CC grid k/127 of the template range, drawn at 0.10-0.90 of the range; Level, ChVol, compressor Gain, Hum, Ripple, cab EarlyReflections, Spread, Stereo not varied
di_clips: Guitar-TECHS DI excerpts (data/di, CC BY 4.0): A = fit clip, C = another passage of the same recording (held-out notes); loud-frame level set to -26.7 dBFS; no song audio
mix_stems: none in v1 (oracle isolated target, density d0); separation stress is sep-stress-v1

excluded.other: no Native stand-in ruling covers it (DECISIONS 2026-10-16)
excluded.reverb: all but Room, Plate, 63 Spring, Chamber, Hall
excluded.mod: all but tremolo, 70s Chorus, Bubble Vibrato, MM4 Analog Chorus
